title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory

claims.claim: Wandrd, manyetik kamera kayışı sistemini perşembe günü piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

claims.claim: Wandrd'in Torus Links adı verilen dairesel çapaları 198 pound'a kadar ağırlık taşıyabilir.

evidence.quote: It features a circular anchor similar to Peak Design, called “Torus Links.” The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.
The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.

claims.claim: Torus Link kordonu aşınmaya başladığında siyah kumaşın altında sarı renk görünür.

evidence.quote: If the cord does start to wear down over time, you'll first see yellow under the black fabric—a sign you should replace the Torus Link.

claims.claim: Torus Link kordonu kırmızı renge döndüğünde bağlantının kullanımı derhal bırakılmalıdır.

evidence.quote: If it's red, you should stop using the link immediately—a warning system borrowed from Peak Design.

claims.claim: Wandrd ürünleri için iki yıllık garanti sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: (Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)

claims.claim: Wandrd, kendi sistemini mevcut kayışlarla kullanmak isteyenler için 29 dolara bir DIY kiti satmaktadır.

evidence.quote: If you have a strap you love—maybe a fancy leather strap someone gifted you—Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.
Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

claims.claim: Wandrd manyetik kamera kayışı seti 30-mm boyutu için 69 dolardan satılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69), a 15-mm “Lite

claims.claim: Wandrd manyetik kamera kayışı setinin 15-mm Lite versiyonu 49 dolar, bilek kayışı ise 39 dolardır.

evidence.quote: a 15-mm “Lite
and a wrist strap ($39).
